causal_digest.phenotype: short, ruffled or absent pectoral fin
malformed adult pectoral fin radial skeleton
pectoral fin skeleton and pectoral fin

causal_digest.phenotype_kind: MINERALISATION, and specifically ectopic/pathological mineralisation rather than loss of it: in the paper's words 'ectopic calcifications in a variety of soft tissues', 'pathological mineralization'. Not bone size, not muscle fusion.
causal_digest.phenotype: pathological mineralisation of the pectoral fin cartilage and girdle bone
pectoral fin absent or reduced in size; proximodistal truncation of the fin
pectoral fin bud absent; pectoral fin absent; scapulocoracoid absent (ikarus t22030), or small/variable fins (tm127c)

causal_digest.phenotype_kind: other, in the paper's words 'reduced pectoral fin function', with nerves that 'bypass the plexus' and 'enter the fin at ectopic positions' and 'a reduction in the levels of pre- and postsynaptic structures'. This is appendage neural wiring and neuromuscular junction density, not bone mineralisation, bone size or muscle fusion.

causal_digest.phenotype: pectoral fin aplastic or hypoplastic, and pectoral fin cartilage absent
small, dysmorphic pectoral fin with an arrested distal epithelium
hypoplastic pectoral fin rays / loss of the pectoral fin

causal_digest.phenotype_kind: other, in the paper's words 'an asymmetry of the pectoral girdle, which resembles Sprengel's deformity' - a girdle position and symmetry defect, plus 'vertebral fusion' and 'congenital scoliosis' axially. Not mineralisation, not bone size, not muscle fusion; the muscle phenotype is a stem-cell-number and patterning defect ('decreased amount', 'disorganized'), not a fusion defect.

MUSCLE FUSION as the primary phenotype ('defective myoblast fusion', 'essentially mononucleate', ZFIN 'cell-cell fusion / decreased occurrence'), with a secondary bone SIZE and shape phenotype at the girdle, in the paper's words 'narrower and more porous', 'reduced surface area', 'deformed, porous pectoral girdles'. Not a mineralisation phenotype.

causal_digest.phenotype: hypoplastic pectoral fin: shortened cleithrum, shortened endoskeletal disk and shortened fin fold
pectoral fin absent and the cartilaginous pectoral fin girdle missing; cleithrum dermal ossification lost
small pectoral fin with a reduced endoskeletal disc, reduced skeletal cell number, short cleithrum, small scapulocoracoid and reduced actinotrichia; shifting the timing of shh onse
aplastic scapulocoracoid, absent coracoid and a short pectoral fin

causal_digest.phenotype_kind: MINERALISATION first and bone SIZE second, and the paper separates them: the cleithrum is 'slightly smaller' (size) while the generalised defect is 'deficient mineralization' and 'an overall delay in mineralization', with 'hydroxyapatite crystals ... only rarely observed in the matrix vesicles'. Not muscle fusion.

causal_digest.phenotype: pectoral fin bud never forms; pectoral fin absent, or (at reduced Tbx5a dose) malformed and truncated with reduced lepidotrichia

causal_digest.phenotype_kind: both bone MINERALISATION and bone SIZE: ZFIN scores lepidotrichium 'decreased mass density' and 'broken'/'fractured' (mineralisation and quality) and pectoral fin 'decreased size' (size); in the review's words 'Compromised osteogenesis, bone fragility, shortened body axis and malformed craniofacial structures and fin shape'

other, in the paper's words 'muscle-less pectoral fins' - absence of appendicular (pectoral fin) muscle tissue. Not mineralisation, not bone size, and not muscle fusion: the cells never arrive rather than failing to fuse.

causal_digest.phenotype: small, shortened, misshapen pectoral fin (never an absent fin)

task.title: Review for the human: a recommendation per proposal with the decisive evidence

inputs.spec_text: a zebrafish-derived fish with flying-fish-like pectoral fins that survives 20–30 °C as an adult

summary: The baseline zebrafish-adult already survives at 20 and 30 C, so I propose no system-level edits. A dry run scaling the musculoskeletal system by 1.3 left every temperature metric unchanged and added no binding Lean violation. The fin edits belong at the organ or tissue level.

Proposes setting the pectoral length, span and area ratios and the flight muscle fraction to the flying-fish reference values. The dry run showed no new binding Lean violations, and the adult still survives at 20 and 30 °C. Glide at launch_height_m 1 stays infeasible (0 m range), so the fin shape moves toward the spec but the fish does not glide.

Set pectoral span/SL and area/SL² on both fins to the flying-fish reference values. No new binding Lean violations, and adult survival at 20 and 30 °C is unchanged. Glide at launch height 1 m is still infeasible (launch margin −5.5 m/s), so the glide criterion is not met.

Propose raising flight_muscle_fraction from 0.012 to 0.04 on both pectoral muscles, to power the larger fin. The dry run adds no binding Lean violation, and survival at 20 and 30 C is unchanged. The 0.04 value is an assumed placeholder from the flying-fish reference.
